title: Arbor: Tree Search as a Cognition Layer for Autonomous Agents

claims.claim: A scored hypothesis/action tree is shared working memory; failures and Critic findings revise priors or constrain/prune later branches; persistent KB carries parameter-level lessons.
claims.use_limit: Tree methods are capable of evidence-aware control; not proof that every tree is equivalent to every graph.

claims.claim: Orchestrator and Critic have checks and balances with measurement integrity and diagnostic constraints, beyond passive record keeping.
claims.use_limit: Common accuracy/measurement validity gates must not be removed from B/C when testing graph representation.

claims.claim: The no-DFS baseline is a single unstructured agent without a crash revert path; no-Critic runs accept accuracy failures or mismatched concurrency.
claims.use_limit: The removal conditions change structure, recovery or measurement integrity together; these ablations do not identify a pure tree topology effect.

claims.claim: Experiments target AMD inference serving, with a dynamic configurable frontier capability tier and hardware-specific workloads; model training is future work.
claims.use_limit: Do not transfer reported throughput gains to HousePrice MAE, fixed-backbone causality, or universal SOTA.

claims.claim: Repeatability is assessed with two campaigns on each of two model/device pairs, with within-pair KB separation; figures report best throughput.
claims.use_limit: Four campaigns are not a population variance estimate for independent ML programme families; best throughput is not hidden prelocked final artifact.

claims.claim: A storage-full episode includes escalation to a human; broader-impact discussion notes multi-day GPU and substantial inference costs.
claims.use_limit: Do not assert zero-human-intervention across every described episode or a measured overall energy/cost reduction.

disambiguation.different_work: Toward Generalist Autonomous Research via Hypothesis-Tree Refinement

design_delta: A strong tree comparator can have active diagnostics, failure constraints and measurement checks; compulsory-control novelty is not established by graph presence.
